title: The Interactivity of ICT in Language Teaching in the Context of Ukraine University Education
reason: Re-extraction (inclusion not re-decided). Null control-vs-experimental achievement contrast plus correlations among self-reported readiness, motivation and perceived learning; no LMS indicator or scored product, and learning styles are not measured. Would fail I1-I4 (NOREL); flagged.

extraction.country: Ukraine (Uman State Pedagogical University named after Pavlo Tychyna)
extraction.design: experimental/control (2x2 split-plot ANOVA) + survey correlations + focus group
extraction.n_quote: namely the control group numbered 27 people, of which 18 were young women aged 20-21 ... Of 29 individuals in the experimental group, 14 were young women aged 20-21 and 15
extraction.population: 3rd-year full-time philology (Ukrainian language and literature) undergraduates, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: none measured (multimedia textbook on interactive equipment; no LMS or exercise-product indicator recorded or analysed)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: 23-item achievement test (KR-20 = 0.74); self-reported learning readiness, academic motivation, perceived learning
extraction.notes: n is the sum of group sizes 27 + 29; the text states 'the required sample size obtained was 57 people' and Table 3 gives n = 57. No group difference in achievement (Group*Measurement F = .899, p = .344, eta2 = 0.016). Correlations reported are among self-report scales only: 'a positive noteworthy relationship between LR and AM (r=.41, p> .05)', LR-PL r = .69, AM-PL r = .43 (Table 4). Learning styles are named in the abstract but never measured; no visual/auditory/kinesthetic analysis exists in the text. Same full text as calibration record 2-s2.0-85073395065 (excluded NOREL in worklist main). Table 2 cells 'Experimental/control' and 'nr' n: n is now recoverable (27 + 29 = 56; text's 'required sample size' is 57).
